name: Breeze Canna PRO Disposable | Berry Burst
description: Get ready for an explosion of berry goodness! Enhanced with limonene, myrcene, and beta caryophyllene terpenes, Berry Burst brings out your creative and inspired side while keeping you uplifted and energized. It's like having a handful of your favorite mixed berries in convenient vape form – sweet, satisfying, and absolutely bursting with flavor.
